protein_master_table_string.protein_id: STRING protein identifier (e.g. '9606.ENSP00000275493') — join key only; disk column already named protein_id; loader rename is a no-op (canonical name since v2)
protein_master_table_string.gene_symbol: HGNC short gene symbol of the protein (e.g. 'EGFR', 'TP53', 'KRAS'); used to find which protein you are asking about
protein_master_table_string.protein_size: Protein length in amino acids (integer, e.g. 1210 for EGFR) of THIS protein. When this table is joined to a PPI edge it is the QUERY/anchor protein's size; for a PARTNER's size use the PPI table's association_partner_protein_size / physical_partner_protein_size / channels_partner_protein_size column instead (table-prefixed to avoid spurious FK cross-joins)
protein_master_table_string.annotation: Free-text functional protein description from STRING (e.g. 'Receptor tyrosine kinase'); used when asking for protein function or annotation

ppi_association_string.protein_id: STRING protein ID for the query-side protein (non-queryable FK → protein_master_table_string.protein_id)
ppi_association_string.association_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol of the query-side protein in the functional association table — use this to find all functional interaction partners of a named gene (edges are stored bidirectionally so a single filter returns ALL partners)
ppi_association_string.protein_partner_id: STRING protein ID for the partner-side protein (non-queryable FK → protein_master_table_string.protein_id)
ppi_association_string.association_partner_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol of the partner-side protein in the functional association table — this is the interacting partner returned to the user
ppi_association_string.association_score: STRING overall confidence score across all seven evidence channels (integer 0–1000; this snapshot pre-filtered to ≥ 700; 900+ = highest confidence). Users may ask for 'combined score', 'STRING score', or 'interaction confidence'
ppi_association_string.association_partner_protein_size: Amino-acid length of the PARTNER protein on this edge (integer, e.g. 393), denormalized from protein_master_table via protein_partner_id. Use THIS column for any question about the SIZE / LENGTH / amino-acid count of a gene's interaction PARTNERS (e.g. 'partners larger than 1000 aa', 'average partner protein size'). NOTE: the master-table protein_size column is the QUERY/anchor protein's size, not the partner's

ppi_physical_string.protein_id: STRING protein ID for the query-side protein (non-queryable FK → protein_master_table_string.protein_id)
ppi_physical_string.physical_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol of the query-side protein in the physical-binding table — use this to find proteins that physically bind a named gene (direct binding / complex evidence only; subset of ppi_association)
ppi_physical_string.protein_partner_id: STRING protein ID for the physical-binding partner (non-queryable FK → protein_master_table_string.protein_id)
ppi_physical_string.physical_partner_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol of the physical-binding partner — the partner gene that has direct physical / binding evidence with the query gene
ppi_physical_string.physical_score: STRING physical-interaction confidence score from binding and complex evidence only (integer 700–999). Users may ask for 'physical interaction', 'binding evidence', or 'physical PPI'
ppi_physical_string.physical_partner_protein_size: Amino-acid length of the PARTNER protein on this edge (integer, e.g. 393), denormalized from protein_master_table via protein_partner_id. Use THIS column for any question about the SIZE / LENGTH / amino-acid count of a gene's physical-binding PARTNERS. NOTE: the master-table protein_size column is the QUERY/anchor protein's size, not the partner's

ppi_detailed_channels_string.protein_id: STRING protein ID for the query-side protein (non-queryable FK → protein_master_table_string.protein_id)
ppi_detailed_channels_string.channel_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol of the query-side protein in the per-channel evidence table — use this to retrieve per-channel evidence scores for a named gene's interaction partners
ppi_detailed_channels_string.protein_partner_id: STRING protein ID for the partner-side protein (non-queryable FK → protein_master_table_string.protein_id)
ppi_detailed_channels_string.channel_partner_gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol of the partner-side protein in the per-channel evidence table — returned alongside per-channel scores
ppi_detailed_channels_string.neighborhood: Per-channel score: genomic neighbourhood co-location evidence (integer 0–357 in this snapshot; STRING protocol range 0–1000). Users may ask for 'neighborhood score' or 'genomic neighbourhood'
ppi_detailed_channels_string.fusion: Per-channel score: gene-fusion evidence from organism comparisons (integer 0–900 in this snapshot; STRING protocol range 0–1000). Users may ask for 'fusion score'
ppi_detailed_channels_string.cooccurence: Per-channel score: phylogenetic co-occurrence / profile evidence (integer 0–537 in this snapshot; STRING protocol range 0–1000; note schema spelling). Users may ask for 'co-occurrence score' or 'phylogenetic profile'
ppi_detailed_channels_string.coexpression: Per-channel score: gene co-expression evidence across organisms (integer 0–1000). Users may ask for 'co-expression score'
ppi_detailed_channels_string.experimental: Per-channel score: experimental/biochemical evidence from BioGRID, IntAct etc. (integer 0–1000). Users may ask for 'experimental score' or 'experimental evidence'
ppi_detailed_channels_string.database: Per-channel score: curated-database evidence from Reactome, KEGG etc. (integer 0–984 in this snapshot; STRING protocol range 0–1000). Users may ask for 'database score' or 'curated evidence'
ppi_detailed_channels_string.textmining: Per-channel score: text-mining evidence from co-mentions in PubMed (integer 0–1000). Users may ask for 'text-mining score' or 'literature evidence'
ppi_detailed_channels_string.channel_combined_score: STRING combined confidence score across all channels for this edge (integer 700–999 in this pre-filtered snapshot) — returned alongside per-channel scores for context
ppi_detailed_channels_string.channels_partner_protein_size: Amino-acid length of the PARTNER protein on this edge (integer, e.g. 393), denormalized from protein_master_table via protein_partner_id. Use THIS column for any question about the SIZE / LENGTH / amino-acid count of a gene's interaction PARTNERS. NOTE: the master-table protein_size column is the QUERY/anchor protein's size, not the partner's

protein_alias_string.protein_id: STRING protein identifier (join key to protein_master_table_string.protein_id) — non-queryable FK; disk column already named protein_id; loader rename is a no-op (canonical name since v2)
protein_alias_string.alias: Alternate identifier or synonym for the protein (e.g. RefSeq accession, Ensembl ID, gene symbol). Users may ask for 'alias', 'synonym', or 'alternate ID'
protein_alias_string.source: Source database for the alias (e.g. 'Ensembl_EMBL', 'UniProt_AC', 'Ensembl_HGNC'). Users may ask for 'alias source' or 'source database'
